text:
Alex: alerting — admission-control started rejecting requests in GPU pool 'usw1-gpu-a' :warning: queue length is 620 / 640 (≈96%). Grafana panels: https://grafana.redwood/p/abc123/usw1-pool
Mia: oncall here, looking. any recent deploys?
deploy-bot: Deployment event: service=frontend-canary commit=adf3b4 started rollout to cluster=usw1 at 2026-03-17T12:10Z. Canary weight=10%.
Raj: that canary bumped synchronous batch size, might increase pressure. seeing many small <64 token requests from integ-tests.
Lina: can we temporarily reduce canary weight or disable sync batching?
Raj: I can roll back canary or change config. propose `kubectl patch configmap admission -n inference --type merge -p '{"data":{"max_concurrent":"600"}}'` to nudge limits while we investigate
Mia: prefer non-invasive change first — reduce canary weight to 0.5% via rollout tool. @Raj can you?
Raj: done — reduced to 0.5% :white_check_mark:
Alex: dashboard shows queue dropping but admission control still triggering for a few pools (usw1-a, usw1-b).
ops-oncall: I started a temporary burst scale request to DedicatedPool with `POST /api/admin/scale?pool=usw1-burst&delta=4` — we should see 4 extra GPUs in ~5 min.
Lina: thumbs on burst, but cost note — this will bill as on-demand add-ons. track in #finance if sustained.
Alex: agree. If queue falls we avoid rollback. Observability: `histogram.admission.latency` spiked to 1.2s.
Mia: routing policy also sent traffic to usw2 fallback earlier; however latency for fallback is higher. Users complaining.
Raj: logs show a flurry of tiny 1-token sanity checks from an internal canary test harness — opened PR to throttle them: https://git.redwood/pr/234
Lina: taking ownership to update runbook to add 'reduce canary weight' as step 2. I'll create a short doc.
Alex: after scale up queues at 65%, admission control cleared. We'll monitor for 30m. If it resurfaces, we'll consider tuning `admission.max_queue_per_gpu` and move to scheduled autoscale.
Mia: creating incident ticket INC-20260317-33 and paging SRE rotation.
ops-oncall: paging done. also added Grafana alert suppression for the burst scale window.
Alex: follow-ups: (1) add a metric for small-request density, (2) evaluate batching config change for canaries, (3) cost analysis for burst usage — assign to Raj/Lina/Mia respectively.
Lina: noted, I'll update runbook + link to ticket.
Raj: PR to throttle test harness will land in ~10m. thanks all.
deploy-bot: Scale event: pool=usw1-burst delta=4 status=success at 2026-03-17T12:16Z.
Alex: closing thread once green for 30m.
